notes.title: Patch notes 1.3.3
notes.content:
A small patch with some bug fixes and some visual updates



Fixed some water behaving incorrectly.

Water splash effect was rotated the wrong way, this has been fixed.

Slightly adjusted the ghost movement visuals.

Updated the goal visuals, the goal should be more clear and easier to see.

notes.title: Patch notes 1.3.2
notes.content:
Ghosts are now enabled by default, you can still toggle them off in the pause menu.

Fixed an issue where long names from the leaderboard would clip into the ghost body.

notes.title: Patch notes 1.3.1
notes.content:
Ghost files were being uploaded as private which prevented players from downloading them.



Newly created ghost files are now uploaded as public(Previously private).

notes.title: Controller Support
notes.content:
Added controller support.



Let us know if there are any issues with it, either in-game or the UI.

notes.title: Patch notes 1.1.0 - Added widescreen support
notes.content:
We have now worked on adding support for widescreen and ultra widescreen. We don't have a widescreen to test on, so if there are any issues arising regarding widescreen, please let us know.

Added widescreen support (21:9 and 32:9).
